note: Made-up journal for testing and the demo. Not a real person's diary. Planted patterns are listed in docs/sample-month-answers.md.
goals: Save money for rent. Finish assignments early. Sleep before midnight. Cook at home instead of buying takeout. The planned Thursday shawarma night with Maya is my one treat a week and is fine.

entries.text: First day back. Bought rice, eggs and frozen veg. Cooked a big pot. Read the course outlines.
Library from 11 to 3. Started the data structures reading. Cooked at home.
Finished the first lab at the library. Walking home I told myself I earned it and grabbed shawarma for $16.
Quiet day. Studied two hours, cooked rice, called my sister.
Planned to start the essay but watched videos all afternoon instead. I'll start fresh tomorrow.
Actually started the essay. Wrote the outline. Leftover rice for dinner.
Submitted the quiz early. On the way home I thought I deserve something and got takeout again, $14.
Scrolled my phone in bed until 2am. Woke up at 11 and missed the morning study block.
Thursday shawarma night with Maya, planned since Monday. Split the bill, $9. Good night.
Skipped the gym and the reading. Felt bad. From tomorrow I'm locking in properly.
Did the reading and half the lab. Cooked pasta.
Finished the lab. Walked past the takeout place and thought I earned it after a long week. $17.
Laundry, cleaned the room, cooked a big pot of curry for the week.
Watched videos in bed until 1:30am. Slept through my alarm and missed the 9am lecture.
Caught up on the lecture notes. Cooked at home. In bed by 11:30.
Was supposed to do the problem set. Played games instead. Tomorrow I'll start fresh and do double.
Did the problem set at the library. Leftover curry.
Handed in the problem set. Told myself I earned a treat and bought takeout on the way back, $15.
Budget check: down to $60 until the 1st. Cooked rice and eggs.
Phone in bed until 2am again. Woke up groggy at 10:30, missed the morning plan.
Studied with a classmate at the library for three hours. Cooked at home.
Didn't open the assignment at all. Said I'd start fresh tomorrow.
Thursday shawarma night with Maya again, planned. $9. Talked about the midterm.
Finished the assignment early for once. Walking home I felt I earned it and got takeout, $16.
Groceries: rice, frozen veg, eggs. $22. Cooked.
Stayed on my phone in bed until 1am. Missed my morning study block again.
Long study day for the midterm. In bed by midnight.
Wrote the midterm. Cooked at home and went to bed early.
